newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Sao Paulo bankruptcies up 5.9 pct in Oct.
newsitem.headline: Sao Paulo bankruptcies up 5.9 pct in Oct.

text.p: Bankruptcy filings in the city of Sao Paulo totalled 1,127 in October, a rise of 5.9 percent over the same month last year, Sao Paulo's Commerce Association (ACSP) said in a statement.
October bankruptcy filings also rose 8.57 percent when compared with September, ACSP said.
In addition to the bankruptcy filings, 21 Sao Paulo firms filed for debt relief in October 1996 against 25 in the same month last year, the association said.
October debt relief filings also rose when compared with September, when 14 firms filed for debt relief, it said.
